Package simple.crypto

Interface CryptoEngine

All Superinterfaces:
RawCryptoEngine
All Known Implementing Classes:
AES
public interface CryptoEngine extends RawCryptoEngine
A cryptographic engine interface that extends RawCryptoEngine.

This interface defines generic methods for encrypting and decrypting data. Implementations are expected to handle object serialization and deserialization internally.
